notes.title: News about the future of the game
notes.content:
I am not working on Coraland anymore but I still keep the project in mind. I've been throught some stuff regarding my personal life and the game and I plan on working again on the game maybe in 1 or 2 years.

I still plan on finishing Coraland but i'm not sure anymore about a lot of stuff regarding the game and I'm not going anywhere with it. I might start the project from scratch again.
